implementationContracts.raw: SearchRaw four nonnull strings; RawStringModelBinder preserves blank and whitespace (no ConvertEmptyStringToNull/Trim). SearchCriteria nullable normalized values only on explicit search. New/Cancel/Discard use technical bounds/valid encoding/keys, no search business validation/normalization/default employment reapplication
implementationContracts.invalidSelectRaw: Unknown/whitespace code uses screen-only selected data-invalid-raw option and encoded/pre-wrap explanation. Re-capture select.value exactly; do not add to allowed master candidates. Search rejects MSG-016
implementationContracts.searchSync: Ordered MutationQueue, ClientSequence/Revision and full raw/scroll in Open/Export. Server compares all raw Ordinal before capture: difference invalidates ResultValid/Rows/Selection/TotalCount and sets Unapplied. New proceeds without valid results; row Edit/Export reject after invalidation
implementationContracts.open: Normal a New/rowEdit uses POST open full raw capture then HTTP200 NavigationEnvelope with unconsumed display-ticket URL; client performs exactly one GET; row edit establishes that result row as selected. Export requires server selection1 and result membership, New has no selection requirement
implementationContracts.return: SearchReturnSnapshot carries raw4/LastApplied/status/result validity/selection/scroll/owner. Success only re-fetches applied once, restores prior or saved member and clamped scroll. Unsearched/Unapplied/Failed/LimitExceeded restore exact raw/status with search0, even if old applied criteria exists. Saved notice only for known commit success
implementationContracts.physicalCancel: F04-I29/F06-I10 type=button; capture current DOM parent/current career/code raw before dirty evaluation, bypass HTML validity/Save/requestSubmit. Untouched New has no confirmation. Invalid input can be explicitly discarded; Continue preserves input/tab/target/focus. ConfirmationId binds revision/action/target/raw digest
implementationContracts.keys: Tab natural DOM with readonly values copyable; textarea Enter newline, composing Enter never duplicate-submit; real tabs with arrows/Home/End/Enter/Space and target panels; destructive confirmation defaults Continue and Esc continues; error opens same target tab/row and links to field
implementationContracts.ownership: Minimal extensions inside existing ScreenStateStore only: Session/Tab/State/document lease, one-use60s navigation ticket, immutable search resume ref, confirmation id. Key generation/owner/expiry/destruction/MSG are in one method-common table; no DB/new generic service/heartbeat
implementationContracts.history: history.state contains only opaque search ref/sourceTab. Valid back/forward/reload copies immutable search snapshot to NEW StateId/lease/ref, retains status/raw/applied/selection/scroll; Success refreshes applied once, other statuses query0. Duplicate-tab copy never shares or changes original live State/Draft/lease. Direct no-ref GET is initial; expired ref MSG041/initial. Edit reload reads latest saved values and may inherit only search return snapshot, never unsaved edit Draft
implementationContracts.bfcache: Persisted F03 with valid search ref takes one guarded fresh GET /employees/reload then resume before UI enable, not old-lease dead end. Edit/code current input/failure/Unknown retains DOM and blocks operations on expired lease; no automatic initialize/rePOST
implementationContracts.stateExpiry: MSG-041 technical UI state expiry only when authentication still valid. Priority authMSG002 -> owner/roleMSG003 -> Busy/UnknownMSG029/034 -> UI-stateMSG041 -> business validation/DB. Keep current DOM/target/copy on old document, explicit discard-and-reread only; reread failure keeps old display/CanSave=false
implementationContracts.commitVsNavigation: Keep NotStarted/RolledBack/Committed/Unknown separate. No navigation ticket from Busy/Unknown/save failure. Known Committed plus ticket failure is saved+navigation failure (MSG014+041), not Unknown or save failure. Never automatic save retry; Unknown requires existing current-value enquiry
implementationContracts.limitations: Browser forced leave before pending raw/checkpoint acknowledgement can restore only last acknowledged search snapshot; show pending/failure and standard warning where supported. App New/Open always waits for full raw capture. Beforeunload custom wording/all-environment firing/unsaved draft recovery are not guaranteed
implementationContracts.transport: DQA-UI05: protected same-origin fetch JSON with CSRF, redirect:error and expected status/content-type/shape. Navigation success200 envelope -> client one GET; no POST error document, no fetch303 preconsumption. Failures keep current GET document/raw/tab/selection; reload must never rePOST Save. Login native POST303 retained. Exact2MiB body limit and FormOptions per-value16384 retained without putting aggregate JSON into one form field.
